subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.------TR.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 81 ((AF)D-9). AF-POST (affinity postulation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From TR: RE-ST (restructuralism). From DYM-SPT: BIA (bi-aitional) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From RE-ST: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From ALT-F: A-PR (all-purpose). From INFO-DY: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: AF-N and PART (participation).
